facts.fact: The ADD's December 2024 operational manual on open data standards says the national open data portal was launched in 2011, that the Agence de Développement du Digital coordinates the Open Data programme and is responsible for the portal, and that every dataset published there must meet its minimum quality criteria; it states that the portal hosts datasets of some administrations and references datasets on sector portals, names no ministry or agency that has released data and gives no dataset or publisher count, and ties the portal to no open data policy, strategy or law.

facts.fact: The Open Government Partnership commitment page says Morocco set up the open data platform data.gov.ma in 2011, a pioneer, though its use remains very limited.

The commitment sets as baseline, doubling by 2020, 10 institutions adhering to open data and 100 datasets published on data.gov.ma; the baseline is dated to the start of the commitment period (August 2018), the page giving no other date.

facts.fact: The IRM report says the national portal data.gov.ma held over 500 datasets by end 2023 with over 70,000 downloads, according to the Digital Development Agency.
The IRM report says 37 institutions were updating datasets on the data.gov.ma platform by end 2023, and over 180 open data officers had been designated.
